title: ROSS1000 daily movement
description: Confirm the property's capacity on the selected day. CasaZen reads arrivals and departures from recorded check-ins and check-outs.

states.preview_only: Local preview. Direct submission must be active on the selected date to send.
states.correction: This movement has changed since acceptance. You can submit the correction.
states.sending: Submission in progress or interrupted. Check the movement in the portal before taking action.
states.unknown: Outcome unknown. Check this day in ROSS1000 before proceeding.
states.rejected: Rejected records: {{rejected}}. Check the portal and correct the data before resubmitting.
states.partial: Accepted records: {{accepted}}. Rejected records: {{rejected}}. Complete the correction in the portal.
states.credentials_rejected: ROSS1000 rejected the credentials. Update them before retrying.

errors.invalid_capacity: Check the opening status, available rooms, occupied rooms and available beds.
errors.legacy_checkout: Some departing guests arrived under the previous sender. Reconcile their records in the portal.
errors.guest_count_incomplete: The registered guests do not match the number on the booking.
errors.invalid_guest: Complete each guest's type, sex and date of birth.
errors.invalid_group: Check guest order and group leaders in the check-in.
errors.missing_residence: Complete the guests’ residence in the check-in.
errors.invalid_place_code: Complete the official citizenship and residence codes.
errors.unsupported: This property is outside the supported territory.
errors.disabled: Direct ROSS1000 submission is awaiting activation.
errors.route_or_day: Check the activation date for direct submission and choose a day that has already begun.
errors.credentials_missing: Enter the ISTAT credentials and ROSS1000 property code.
errors.missing_actual_date: An actual arrival or departure date is missing. Check the guest registration.
errors.manual_correction: Previously submitted records have been removed. Reconcile them in the portal.
errors.preview_changed: The data has changed. Prepare a new preview.
errors.already_processing: Another submission is in progress for this day.
errors.request_failed: The request did not complete. Open the preview again to check the status.
